question: For the experimental grouped-Claw update command, is the supported v1 recovery contract allowed to stop at `update_partial` plus manual inspection/replanning, or must merge wait for a durable doctor/retry/reconcile operation identity?
rationale: The patch deliberately preserves uncertain state after unreceipted package and scheduler mutations; selecting the operator recovery guarantee is a product and support commitment rather than a mechanical code correction.

options.title: Require durable recovery before merge
options.body: Add a documented doctor/retry/reconcile operation identity and prove recovery across the non-transactional package and Gateway boundaries before accepting mutation support.

options.title: Accept explicit partial-state recovery
options.body: Keep the experimental fail-closed `update_partial` contract, require exact-head live proof, and document manual inspection plus replan as the supported v1 recovery path.

recommendation.title: Require durable recovery before merge
recommendation.body: Add a documented doctor/retry/reconcile operation identity and prove recovery across the non-transactional package and Gateway boundaries before accepting mutation support.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment identifies the exact recovery and aggregate-capability decision that maintainers must resolve.
